name: Staves
overview: In Zechariah 11, staves are used symbolically to represent God's covenant and authority over His people, as seen when the prophet takes two staves named Beauty and Bands to shepherd the flock. The breaking of the staff Beauty signifies the breaking of God's covenant with the people, a powerful prophetic act that communicates judgment and separation. Additionally, the staves serve as instruments of discipline and warning, reflecting both God's care and the consequences of rebellion among His people.
